label: A Common Form
subgoals: Rational numbers can be written as fractions, decimals or integers.
Negative numbers are ordered in reverse: -5 is less than -2 even though 5 is greater than 2.

label: Comparing Pairs
subgoals: On a number line, the number farther left is smaller.
A quick benchmark such as zero, one half or one can often settle a comparison without exact conversion.

label: Ordering Lists
subgoals: Sort a list by repeatedly comparing neighbours, or place every number on a sketch of the number line.
Check the final order by reading from left to right.
Ordering is the first step in finding a median, a range or a solution interval.
